title: SaltyNX
author: shinyquagsire23, masagrator
details:
SaltyNX is a background process that enables runtime file and code modification in retail games.

SaltyNX provides the underlying framework used by tools such as FPSLocker and other game-modification plugins.
changelog:
2.1.3

Fix support for LÖVE engine games that were broken when SaltyNX logo was enabled, this includes Balatro.
